name: Blumenau

routes.outcome: Official municipal GEO portal identifies lot consultation, cadastral thematic maps, WFS access, and geospatial downloads for Blumenau.

Official municipal service page identifies Consulta de dados cadastrais de um imóvel, including lot map, and names Secretaria de Planejamento Urbano (SEPLAN) as the responsible órgão. It describes an online service but its administrative data requirements were not used.
Official municipal notice identifies Diretoria de Cartografia, Cadastro Multifinalitário e Certificações and points to geo.blumenau.sc.gov.br for base cartography and lot queries.
Public ArcGIS FeatureServer service description says Lotes do município de Blumenau; layer 0 is Cadastro de Lotes; source spatial reference is EPSG:31982; query is public and supported.

Layer metadata reports esriGeometryPolygon, supported query formats JSON and geoJSON, maxRecordCount 3000, full municipal extent, and fields including OBJECTID and GLOBALID. Source-specific attributes were inspected for schema only and not retained.

Bounded anonymous query returned three Polygon features with OBJECTID and GLOBALID and geometry transformed to EPSG:4326. Retained sample keeps only GLOBALID in each feature properties object; no unsafe fields were requested.

Official WFS metadata page documents the municipal WFS endpoint and states layer updates follow internal geospatial-base maintenance, daily for some layers and on demand for others. WFS GetCapabilities request was attempted but timed out after 30 seconds; no conclusion about WFS availability was made.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Municipal GEO portal; ArcGIS REST service metadata was used as the current public service configuration.
schemaAndCrs.sourceCrs: EPSG:31982 (SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone 22S as reported by the service)
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: GLOBALID is the retained canonical native identity; OBJECTID was observed as an ArcGIS OID but is not retained in the sample properties.
schemaAndCrs.sourceFieldMapping: Observed layer fields include OBJECTID, MSLINK_DBA, NOBAIRRO, IQ, NUMLOTE, LOTEAMENTO, subdivision/creation/modification/status fields, GLOBALID, UNIQUEROWID and edit metadata. Only GLOBALID was requested for retained identity; no raw attribute set was retained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: where=1=1 with resultRecordCount=3; outFields=OBJECTID,GLOBALID; returnGeometry=true; outSR=4326

localCustodianAssessment: The Prefeitura Municipal de Blumenau, through Secretaria de Planejamento Urbano (SEPLAN) and its Diretoria de Cartografia, Cadastro Multifinalitário e Certificações, is evidenced as the local cadastral/geospatial custodian. This is stronger than general national-agency prose because the first-party municipal service and data portal directly publish the lot layer and consultation service.

qualification.reason: A public first-party parcel identity-and-geometry service was evidenced, but runtime adapter admission remains a separate serial review. This packet does not alter runtime configuration.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The bounded query was not an exact-point lookup and no citywide completeness claim is made from three returned features.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
The sample contains at most three full parcel polygons and exactly one canonical native identity in each properties object.
Native source fields and mapping are documented here; raw source-specific attributes were not retained.
Request caches and qualification evidence are under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/6666/.
TLS verification remained enabled; no certificate exception was used.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was attempted.
WFS GetCapabilities timed out; this does not negate the separately verified ArcGIS FeatureServer route.
uncertainty: The municipal parcel layer and anonymous query route are verified, including native identity and CRS. Coverage/update details are limited to the service metadata and municipal WFS documentation; licensing, historical completeness, and whether every returned parcel is valid for runtime integration remain unresolved.
